Usage: perch wt [<branch>] [--no-switch]
                                  Give the branch its own worktree
       perch wt <worktree-directory-name> <branch> [--no-switch]
                                  Use a custom worktree directory name
       perch wt ls            List worktrees
       perch wt rm [<branch>] Remove a worktree (deletes branch if merged)
       perch wt rm .          Remove the worktree you're in
       perch wt -- <branch>   Worktree a branch named ls/rm/list/remove
       perch wt -- <worktree-directory-name> <branch>
                                  Escape a colliding worktree directory name

Options:
      --no-switch  Create or find the worktree without switching to it
  -f, --force      Skip the confirmation for uncommitted or unmerged work
